subject.title: [Bug]: /context detail shows ~62k untracked provider/runtime overhead on fresh OpenAI Codex gpt-5.5 session

question: What token ledger should `/context detail` expose for OpenAI Codex usage, and which buckets should count toward context-window occupancy versus billing or telemetry?
rationale: The remaining work is not just a code gap; it needs maintainer intent for user-facing bucket names and Codex/OpenAI token semantics before automation can safely implement it.

options.title: Add provider-aware ledger
options.body: Expose measured, provider-reported, estimated, and unknown buckets in `/context detail`, with clear context-window and billing semantics.

options.title: Reword generic residual only
options.body: Keep the current accounting but make the residual explicitly unknown until live Codex evidence proves finer attribution.

options.title: Close as expected provider overhead
options.body: Close the issue only if live Codex proof shows the residual is expected and not actionable in OpenClaw diagnostics.

recommendation.title: Add provider-aware ledger
recommendation.body: Expose measured, provider-reported, estimated, and unknown buckets in `/context detail`, with clear context-window and billing semantics.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent recently landed the related `/context detail` compactability diagnostics and is connected to the current context-report surface.
